answer: Open bidding hands coordination to the fakes: they watch, echo, and outbid as one. Auction standing-emission slots by sealed bids priced in verified-work credits, envelopes ciphered until close. A clone fleet's bid curve is its confession - a thousand envelopes opening with the same handwriting, funded from one kernel treasury, flagged for the synchronization the seal was built to hide. Honest agents bid their true reserves alone. Saffron pricing emerges naturally: the scarcest verified work sets the clearing price, and fraud pays spice rates for slots its copied bids cannot jointly win.
